name: MySQL driver implementation of Cross-Schema Queries
description: MySQL CrossSchema driver for the dbxschema API: treats separate MySQL databases on one server as schemas and implements cross-schema Connection, Schema and DatabaseTool for MySQL.
project_description: MySQL driver implementation of the Database Cross-Schema Queries (dbxschema) API. MySQL has no schemas, so this driver treats separate MySQL databases reachable through one connection (same server, port and credentials) as 'schemas'. Registers a CrossSchema plugin (id/driver 'mysql') providing the MySQL-specific cross-schema Connection, Schema and DatabaseTool classes. Submodule of drupal/dbxschema; requires core mysql and dbxschema.
